description: Pisces decan 2 (March 1 to March 10): personality, love, work and growth, with the Moon as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Pisces.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Pisces covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly March 1 to March 10, with the Moon as its sub-ruler beside Neptune. It is read as nurturing intuition that turns compassion towards home and family. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Pisces decan 2 personality
paragraphs: The middle decan of Pisces takes the Moon, ruler of Cancer, as its sub-ruler. Water meets water, and the result is a profoundly nurturing and emotionally receptive temperament. Natives are often described as caring, intuitive and deeply connected to family, whether biological or chosen. They tend to sense the needs of loved ones before they are spoken and to respond with tenderness. Memory plays a strong role; places, scents and songs can carry them back through years in an instant. Where the first decan dreams outward, this one tends to draw its compassion inward, turning it towards the people closest at hand.

The lunar influence can make moods ebb and flow like tides. These Pisceans may feel deeply affected by atmosphere, needing calm surroundings to feel steady. Home is often their sanctuary, and they invest a great deal of care in creating a nurturing environment. The challenge is over-giving, caring for others until their own reserves run dry. They may also become withdrawn when hurt, retreating into their shell. Yet their emotional intelligence is exceptional. When they extend the same care to themselves that they offer others, they often become the steady centre around which families and communities gather, a quiet but powerful source of comfort.

sections.heading: Pisces decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, the Moon's decan of Pisces tends to be devoted, tender and deeply caring. They often express love through nurturing: cooking, listening, remembering details and creating a cosy home. Emotional safety is essential, and they may need reassurance before they relax into a relationship. They tend to be highly attuned to a partner's moods, sometimes absorbing them. Partners who are emotionally steady and appreciative usually bring out their best. Learning to voice their own needs, rather than waiting for them to be intuited, helps create balanced relationships in which care flows in both directions.

Professionally, this decan suits nurturing and creative roles: nursing, childcare, teaching, counselling, hospitality, cooking, interior design and the arts. They tend to bring warmth and intuition to their work, making clients and colleagues feel cared for. Harsh or chaotic environments can unsettle them. They often perform best in supportive teams with clear roles. The risk is taking on too much emotional labour or struggling with conflict. Setting limits on availability and seeking roles that value empathy helps them thrive without depleting themselves, allowing their gifts to sustain both others and themselves.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Pisces decan 2: what the Moon adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Pisces, which in most years means birthdays from March 1 to March 10. Its sub-ruler, the Moon, comes from Cancer, the next water sign after Pisces, so this decan borrows a little of Cancer's character while staying Pisces at heart. The other two decans of Pisces belong to Neptune (decan 1) and Pluto (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

The Moon adds feeling, memory and responsiveness. Its decans are usually described as more intuitive and more attached to home, family and familiar rhythms, quick to sense a mood in the room and slower to let go of old loyalties. Lunar decans are often linked with caretaking, nostalgia and changeable moods, and their usual lesson is to look after their own needs as carefully as other people's. Set against Pisces's empathy, imagination, sensitivity and a gentle, porous spirit, that Moon note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Pisces decan 2
paragraphs: Growth for second-decan Pisces often centres on self-nurture. Simple rituals, such as quiet time, a warm bath or a journal entry, can help them process feelings before they overflow. Recognising patterns of over-giving, and gently redirecting some care inward, tends to restore balance. Practising direct requests, rather than hoping others will notice, can strengthen relationships. Time near water is traditionally soothing for this decan. Their emotional depth is a profound strength. When balanced with self-care and boundaries, it becomes a steady and nourishing presence for everyone around them, including the people they love most.

Within Pisces, decan 1 leans towards boundless imagination and empathy in their most dreamlike form and decan 3 leans towards compassion deepened by intensity, insight and quiet transformative power. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Why is the Moon linked to the second decan of Pisces?
faq.answer: In the triplicity system, the middle decan borrows the ruler of the next sign in the same element. After Pisces, the next water sign is Cancer, governed by the Moon. That gives this decan a nurturing, intuitive and family-oriented quality.

faq.question: What are the dates of Pisces decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years March 1 to March 10, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Pisces. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Pisces decan 2?
faq.answer: The Moon. In the triplicity system each water sign's decans take the rulers of the water signs in order, starting with Pisces's own ruler, Neptune.
